item.title: Ohio State Dance Team Earns Third Consecutive National Championship
item.description: Ohio State's Dance Team capped off a successful weekend for the Buckeyes at the UCA & UDA National Championships in Orlando. Ohio State secured its third consecutive D1A Jazz National Championship on Sunday, its sixth in the last seven years. The Buckeyes were dominant throughout the day during the competition, producing the highest scores in the preliminary and semifinal rounds, prior to scoring a 96.7833 in the D1A Jazz Finals to secure the championship. item.description: UCLA's bench played double the minutes Ohio State's did in the Buckeyes' 86-74 win over the Bruins on Saturday. Sixty-six minutes to an even 30. This isn't an anomaly of late for Ohio State. item.title: Ohio State Defeats No. 9 TCU, 71-69, For Second Top-10 Win in Nine Days
item.description: Ohio State women’s basketball earned its second top-10 win in nine days at the Coretta Scott King Classic on Monday. item.description: The Big Ten is on top of the college football world for the third year in a row.
